note: Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, agreeing on all 55). Guides are our own words. Counts are the targets PSN tracks. 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned; this file does not assign hidden flags per trophy because the official list gives no per-trophy hidden flag.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself — it is the reward for finishing the whole list, not a task of its own. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then side strands, activities, and collectibles last. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description.
